description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger from step 3, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Valiant Changeling enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Valiant Changeling trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
